Class Delaunay

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.scene.nodes.util.tri.TriangulationMethod
com.j3d.engine.scene.nodes.util.tri.Delaunay
public final class Delaunay extends TriangulationMethod
Constrained Delaunay Triangulation for 3D planar polygons.

Generates an initial valid triangulation inside the polygon boundary and applies Lawson's edge flip algorithm on internal diagonals to maximize the minimum angles, satisfying the Delaunay empty-circumcircle criterion. Includes co-circular angle/length tie-breaking to dissolve symmetric fans.
